title: Finite majority-model extension: all final sizes
paragraphs: These are exact-law optimization calculations for one old and one new scalar sign predictor, total privacy odds 3, RR retention 3/4 and signal 3/5. Accuracy concerns latent orientation, not prediction on a fresh individual. Brackets are certified primal/dual bounds, not statistical confidence intervals.

The final curves use results-v2 and results-n40. The earlier results directory retains serialization failures and is superseded. No-old export is a counterfactual; the composition column is optimized within the declared independent-composition class. Full-cache disclosure leaves orientation accuracy 0.5. Timings are single local observations; sparse-array bytes exclude solver workspace and process peak.

title: Additional finite model families: geometric and ternary learners
paragraphs: The binary old learner is a centrally geometric-noised count threshold; the ternary old learner is a three-class histogram exponential mechanism. The latent class is correctly observed with probability 0.8. Total history odds are 3 and accuracy is latent-class recovery, with all old marginals preserved.

There are ten family/size settings and thirty joint/control attempts. The ternary joint optimizations at n=5 and n=6 reached the 180-second time limit and have no accepted certificate. Their successful controls are retained. The separate completed input-dependent classifier addendum follows.

title: Input-dependent two-leaf classifier extension
paragraphs: This completed addendum exports a whole input-dependent classifier h:{0,1}→{0,1}, selected from four hypotheses, rather than a constant latent-class sign. Each private row includes the feature and both task labels; arbitrary full-row replacement is protected. The old classifier is an exponential-mechanism learner with known complete output law.

All nine joint/no-old/independent-composition cells at n=2,3,4 pass regenerated exact certificate and conditional-factorization checks. The total history odds are 3. Primary utility is expected accuracy on a new population example including label noise, with chance 0.5 and Bayes ceiling 0.8. It must not be compared directly with the earlier latent-orientation accuracy whose ceiling is 1.

The independent comparator is optimized on the full eight-category count space. It is best within the declared independent-composition class, not over all adaptive policies. These finite model classes and single local timings do not establish arbitrary neural-model scalability or operational accuracy.

title: Exact extension executed through the release gate
paragraphs: All twelve final run-v2 paths execute a saved old model followed by exact-certified conditional extension, reserving epsilon 11/10 before first output. Three sequential timing repeats per size measure local engineering cost, not independent utility trials. run-v1 is exploratory and excluded.

The no-gate component verifies and samples the same saved certificate but excludes optimization, registration, transactions and delivery; it is not an equivalent complete system. Initial setup and final audit are separate from the complete two-export time.

title: Uncertain public workloads and privately selected tasks
paragraphs: For n=3 and 10, three frozen public-design policies are evaluated on nine design laws and four held-out laws each. Gamma controls signal and alpha controls agreement between task orientations. These are exact finite-population calculations; the oracle is a law-informed benchmark, not an implementable population-blind policy.

Minimax regret covers the declared finite laws and their mixtures, not every unseen parameter value. The independent-composition control deliberately does not exploit the old output for prediction. Private task selection is separately charged; four selector-odds settings use the same public menu. All channels and the complete selection transcript were checked.

title: Corrected unknown-generator person-level ridge study
paragraphs: The September 28 study has four regimes (weak/strong signal crossed with low/high within-person correlation), 24 independently drawn teachers/source/test worlds per regime, two noise draws per world, and 96 design settings. There are 27,648 arm-history rows and 576 arm-level summaries; these are not 27,648 independent populations.

Persons=400 or 2,000; ten rows/person; response ranks=1,2,5; K=5 or20 model exports; total rho=0.02 or0.2. All five response coordinates already exist. Reuse full releases all moments once; joint projects to the known task span; task_cached caches identical directions; fresh_full releases new full moments; nonprivate ridge and zero are controls. Each candidate history has its own allowance; releasing all experimental arms together would require combined accounting.

Unlike the older fixed-teacher demonstration, no feasible learner knows the realized teacher. Primary unbounded MSE and the clipping endpoint were fixed before this run. Joint beats zero in all 96 cells, but rank-one competent caching matches joint and full-rank reuse matches joint. Rank-two gains can arise from projection before clipping and are not a reduction in retained-coordinate Gaussian variance. Timings and source counts are retained in the complete aggregate companion.

title: Public HMDA, TLC and BTS operational pilot
paragraphs: Three fixed public panels, n=1,000/5,000/20,000, ranks1/2/3, clipping cap0.5/2, total rho1/4, six exports and24 Gaussian draws yield108 settings,864 arm summaries and20,736 arm histories. The15 signed hashed pre-outcome features plus intercept and fixed ridge were not tuned on the final50,000 rows.

This is whole-record replacement privacy for applications, trips and flights. The panels do not support complete person linkage or membership privacy. The source-inspired workloads are not an actual agency request trace and do not run the finite-channel extension LP.

The competent shared-Gram cache equals joint in every cell. Joint beats zero in108/108 but the stronger public auxiliary constant wins in69/108; joint improves in39/108 (all36HMDA,3TLC,0BTS). The intervals condition on the fixed panels, with nested training prefixes and common randomness. At cap0.5 all records are clipped and at cap2 none is clipped; differences include bias and ridge effects. Public nonprivate controls and ideal floating Gaussian experiments do not constitute a confidential production release.

title: Central audit gate and person-model integration
paragraphs: The final matched accounting benchmark has108 trials:12 workload settings×3 realizations×3 representations, with2,808 proposals and zero oracle-decision mismatches. All36 paired flat/graph histories agree exactly. Graph representation supports provenance but does not improve the privacy rule or establish a universal speed advantage.

benchmark-v2 is the completed accounting comparison; benchmark-v1 was stopped and retained. benchmark-v3 separately measures batch identity registration and does not replace the accounting experiment. integration-v3 is the latest bounded producer smoke run; earlier integration snapshots are superseded. Five fresh sources charge the shared person account once each regardless of the two recipients.

title: Historical September26 person-level utility study
paragraphs: This earlier study fixes one public teacher and uses64 independent source/test worlds (16/regime), two noise draws per world and five overlapping population profiles. It contains46,080 arm-history rows and399,360 coefficient records. The360settings×fourprivate strategies are alternative histories, each with its own allowance.

Population codes specify people and rows/person: n400_r1, n400_r5, n400_r10, n4000_r1 and n800_r5. Modes repeat, rotate and diverse use already measured response coordinates. K=1/5/20 and rho=0.02/0.2. The primary endpoint was unbounded final-task MSE. Range clipping and the known-public-generator control were added after seeing results; analysis-v3 fixes ambiguous diagnostic names fromanalysis-v2 without refitting models.

Both primary and post-hoc endpoints are retained here to avoid hiding unfavorable results. The newer September28 unknown-teacher study strengthens controls and caching, but it does not erase this historical evidence. All3,192saved paired contrasts, clipping/source-noise diagnostics and original reference/noise-excess fields are retained without rounding in current_aggregates.json.
